objective: Re-review commit 0cbedf0, the repair of two code blockers found in the review of 7ac8084, and say whether each is closed without new defects.
scope: Only the diff of commit 0cbedf0 (git show 0cbedf0, also at /tmp/holyagent-review/0cbedf0.diff) in packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts, packages/runtime/src/cli/report.ts, packages/runtime/src/cli/overview.ts and their tests.

Previous finding A: tree.ts fetchEnvironment injected GIT_SSH_COMMAND unless GIT_SSH_COMMAND or GIT_SSH was set, overriding a configured core.sshCommand. Expected fix: keep the configured command and add BatchMode and ConnectTimeout non-interactively.

Previous finding B: report.ts took every following unindented line after an empty-support key line as support, so 'parses:' then 'Looks fine.' accepted. Expected fix: only contiguous list items or indented lines directly below count.
Previous small item: a null workflow result was written as the report 'null'; it should write no file.
constraints: Read-only: make no edits and no version-control writes. Run tests if useful.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as the repository rules.
Keep working until the review is done, then stop and report under 400 words; do not start further review rounds. Each evidence entry on one line as '<criterion label>: <support>'.

criteria.text: Finding A: closed or still open, with file:line support, including quoting of a core.sshCommand that contains spaces or quotes
Finding B: closed or still open, with the shapes checked
New defects: any blocking regression the repair introduced, or none, with support
Tests: each fix has a test that would fail without it

result:
result: Both blockers are closed and I found no new blocking defect. The three runtime test files pass: `bun test packages/runtime/tests/state-branch.test.ts packages/runtime/tests/reports.test.ts packages/runtime/tests/cli.test.ts` -> exit 0, 108 pass, 0 fail.

changed: none (read-only)

checks: I did not run `mise run verify` and did not rebuild or diff the `dist` plugin output, so I did not check the generated copy of these changes.

blockers: none

questions: none

notes (all optional):
- `LIST_ITEM` at `report.ts:21` omits the `[ ]`/`[x]` prefix that the strip regex on the line below accepts. An unindented `[x] ran it` line under an empty key is therefore not support, while `- [x] ran it` is. The fix is small: derive `list` from whether the strip changed the line.
- Appending the options to a `core.sshCommand` that is not OpenSSH-shaped (a wrapper, plink, or `ssh ... || true`) may misbehave. This is a design tradeoff.
- When `GIT_SSH` is set together with `core.sshCommand`, `chosen` is true, so no BatchMode is added. Git ranks `core.sshCommand` above `GIT_SSH`. This edge existed before the repair.
- An empty-string result still writes a file. This is out of scope.
- Reviewing the first `/code-review` finding (plain prose under an empty key line is no longer accepted), I rejected it. That narrowing is the requested fix and is tested.
- The `overview.ts` and `workflows.md` wording changes are outside the two blockers. I leave them as optional.

evidence:
- Finding A: closed. `tree.ts:491` reads `core.sshCommand` through `git config --get`, and `fetchEnvironment` builds `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` as `${configured ?? "ssh"} -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5` (`tree.ts:440` onward). A value with spaces or quotes is appended verbatim to the string git runs as a shell command, so its quoting is kept. I did not run a quoted-path case. An env `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` or `GIT_SSH` is left alone, and a failing config read becomes "no configured command".
- Finding B: closed. I checked these shapes in `report.ts:150-167` and the tests at `cli.test.ts:572-598`. Refused: `parses:` then unindented `Looks fine.`; `parses:` then a key line; `parses:` then a blank line then `- ran it`; unindented prose then a list. Accepted: `- ` and numbered items directly below, indented lines directly below, and nested sub-bullets (`cli.test.ts:~540`).
- Null result: it now writes no file (`report.ts` `entry.result !== null`). `reports.test.ts:148` asserts it is neither listed nor written.
- New defects: none. The config read adds one git spawn per fetch and cannot fail the fetch. The dist and doc changes are generated or wording only. I rated the other `/code-review` findings optional (see notes).
- Tests: each fix has a test that fails without it. The core.sshCommand test (`state-branch.test.ts:371`) needs `Configured=yes` in the ssh log, which the old override of the configured command could not produce. The shape tests at `cli.test.ts:572-598` fail on the old code, which took any unindented line as support. The null-result test (`reports.test.ts:148`) fails on the old code, which wrote a `null` report.
- verdict: both blockers closed, no new blocking defect, merge-ready from the code side.

acceptance.rationale: Verdict cites file:line and the tests that fail on the old code; consistent with the diff.
